decisions.briefing: The market was mixed. The NASDAQ rose 1.1% and the S&P 500 gained only 0.3%, so the signal is neutral. Cash is $345.88, below the $500 buy threshold, so I'm not adding a new position even though IONQ and FRVO scored highly. I'm keeping all seven holdings and letting the automatic profit targets and stop-losses work.

market_education.summary_en: Tech stocks did better than the rest of the market today: the NASDAQ rose 1.1% while the broader S&P 500 gained only 0.3%. That gap suggests buyers are focusing on growth areas such as quantum computing, nuclear energy and crypto miners, which fill much of today's screener, rather than buying across the whole market. No news headlines came with today's data, so this explanation is based only on index moves and price momentum.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技股表現優於大市，納斯達克指數上升1.1%，而標普500指數僅升0.3%。兩者表現分化，反映資金集中流入量子運算、核能及加密貨幣礦企等增長板塊，而非全面買入大市，今日篩選名單亦多屬這些板塊。由於今日數據未附新聞標題，以上分析僅根據指數走勢及價格動能。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash drag is the return you give up when part of a portfolio sits in cash instead of being invested. With only about 2% of this portfolio in cash, the drag is tiny. Forcing a small, poorly sized trade just to use that cash would add more risk than return.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「現金拖累」是指投資組合中部分資金以現金持有、未有投入市場，因而少賺的回報。目前這個組合的現金只佔約2%，影響輕微。若為了用盡這筆現金而勉強建立一個規模過小的倉位，增加的風險反而會大於回報。
